description: Agents push to agent-trunk (no PR required); the system raises ONE batched PR to the protected main when work passes thresholds. Enforcement is three pieces, all on existing rails: (1) platform/github/ruleset.idp.agent-trunk.json -- no force, no deletion, linear history, applied by the EXISTING bin/repo-rulesets; (2) .github/workflows/agent-trunk-batch.yml -- four times a day opens/updates one agent-trunk->main PR, refuses to batch a red trunk, and lets merge-when-green/deploy-when-green land it (it opens, never merges); (3) .githooks/pre-push advises on a direct-to-main push but does not block (LAW 38). Plus jev_pr_risk/bin/idp-pr-risk/bin/idp-pr-risk-gate for pre-submission scoring that refuses ONLY on a real probability.
name: Dual-trunk enforcement
